name: UNIV 4612
title: Showcasing your Competencies: Crafting Pre-Health Applications, Part 2
description: Follows UNIV 4611. Key issues in the pre-health journey, emphasizing letters of recommendation, selecting schools, personal statements, and secondary essays.
requirement_description: UNIV 4611, instructor consent required. Not open for credit to students who have passed UNIV 4610 or UNIV 3995 when offered as "Post-Baccalaureate Seminar: Preparing for Health Professions II," or as "Showcasing your Competencies: Crafting Pre-Health Applications, Part 2," or as "Showcasing your Competencies: Crafting Pre-Health Applications."
